About Demopolis

Demopolis is a London ward-level political–demographic atlas for the 7 May 2026 local elections. It combines two views:

Results

Each of the 674 London wards is coloured by its 2026 outcome — winning party, each Big-5 party's vote share, top-2 margin, or turnout. Source: Democracy Club volunteers' transcription of council Declarations of Result, supplemented for Brent / Newham / Redbridge / Tower Hamlets by direct parses of council and Wikipedia pages.

Bivariate explorer

Pick any party share (X axis) and any of 22 curated census 2021 indicators (Y axis) across 7 substantive groups: education, age, ethnicity, national identity / religion, class & occupation, tenure, mobility & deprivation. Wards are classified into tertiles on each axis and assigned one of nine colours. The stats panel reports the bivariate Pearson r and the standardised OLS partial effect (controlling for 30 other census variables) for the selected combination.

Coverage caveats

The 2026 cycle is England only — no Scottish or Welsh local elections. Within London, four boroughs (Newham, Tower Hamlets, Brent, Redbridge) were slow publishers and were filled from non-DC sources. Newham's vote counts are mostly placeholder ("winners-only synthetic") because Wikipedia editors hadn't recorded per-candidate votes for most Newham wards by the time the data was snapshotted; ward winning party for those wards is correct, vote shares are not.

Data sources

Democracy Club · Open Council Data UK · ONS Census 2021 · ONS May 2024 ward boundaries (BSC).
